Page 12

Ihluön! Look at those gleams still radiating even when we are stripped of the sun's illumi- nation!

  • Among those beneath our feet and sometimes still outside our doors, among those same ones who prevent, deprive, steal and carry off the shining thread behind what was said - or as the infected air trembling from their putrefied throat puts it: "Among the dead and the strangers to thought abstracting the meaning of the words of our thoughts" - thus among those ones we imitated and sometimes still imitate those gleams up there as well as everything that moves, under one and the same seal: *
  • They point, name and carve in clay these "stars in the night" into… "gods" or else into… "life". Not only hiding thus the pastures of our finds by burying them in clay, but also and from then on preventing the seizing of our hunts for they flee the desert of dust they raised, enraging thus on this dead ground our herds, which unravel in rage the thread binding them all into one flock and which alone could carry both our riches and our assemblies upon their backs. Or once again according to their speech, they "thus destroy our logical understanding of things".
  • Indeed, they thus veil the brilliance of all that which cannot be seen, the latter being dimmed within the very bursts of riches themselves more radiant and admired by all at almost every instant. They veil it - this brilliance - because they only name what cannot be bound, or else they only name what cannot be pointed to! And through these names then threading no beast into any pasture, their assemblies and their riches float upon an ocean where neither you nor I can float, continuing their journey while leaving all that behind - they do not "explain" but appear all the same to "understand" with a nod - "what comes from nowhere and without cause".
  • What they thus name themselves "fantasy" - or else… "magic" - they also call, according to us and in their ill - weighed exchanges,… "reason behind causes"! Yet according to them too, these two threads are other and NOT one - or as they say so proudly: "Magic and Reason are antagonistic and opposed"!
  • But why then, Ihluön, do they declare war between their names of "Magic and Reason" when for us they seem to speak - but in their words alone - of one and the same thread? I tell you, Ihluön:
  • Their war is only thus declared because all guide themselves by one same thread indeed, but this one binds no beasts into one and the same herd - "they speak one same language, but emptied of meaning".
  • We alone have "reason" as they would say, for our threads, them, bind the brilliance of what is hidden in order to draw from it the deepest riches and show them to all, while their threads, them, attach to nothing and only pull up their thread itself!
  • Thus then Ihluön, let me make shine what cannot be seen behind what is, so that you may see it with your dreaming eyes, to discover, seize and bind the cattle of your thread when you will see riches or assemblies as if engendered from a nod - "from nowhere and without cause" - when you will feel the dance of the HISM.
  • Indeed Ihluön, let me now and through their words: "Make shine, illuminate, and enluminé all that is unmemoried, invisible and inexplicable, so that from these magical causes I may birth through fantasy: their image, henceforth animated, manifest and imaginable by all."

Here thus is his Tale; That of Aethôrn Ieuphemund Winsgil - Bël'gon, poet of the fourth era.
